+ * + * The limit is about 10^15 because double values will no longer be able to represent + * larger integers with exact precision beyond this limit. + * + * @param value the value that needs to be snapped + * @param snapToPixel whether to snap to pixel + * @param snapScale the scaling factor + * @return value either as passed, or floored or ceiled with scale, based on snapToPixel + */ + public static double snapPortion(double value, boolean snapToPixel, double snapScale) { + if (!snapToPixel || value == 0) { + return value; + } + + return value > 0 ?
